title: NicholeRx: Strung Out
description:
Includes triggers from NicholeRx: Quick Hits

It looks like your Nichole levels have been inconsistent. That’s not good for you. Lucky for you, I have the perfect treatment. I’m going to fractionate the fuck out of you, taking you up, bringing you down, over and over, until you feel exactly what happens when you let your Nichole levels drop. By the time I’m done with you, you’ll know, deep in your body, deep in your mind, that the only cure… is more of me.

So much so, you can almost taste it. 

Love, Goddess 💋
author: Goddess Nichole
